Deloitte – Technical Interview (Round 1) | Azure Data Engineer
Interview Duration: 40 mins

I recently appeared for the first round of the technical interview at Deloitte for Azure Data Engineer role. The round focused on hands-on problem-solving, cloud architecture, SQL logic, and PySpark-based data processing.
I’m sharing my experience to help others preparing for similar opportunities.

Here’s a quick summary of the questions I was asked:

1. Project Architecture & Challenges
 • Explained the end-to-end architecture of my project
 • Discussed challenges faced and how I handled them
2. SQL Joins – Output Rows
 • Explained expected number of rows for INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL OUTER joins
3. Removing Duplicates in SQL
 • Shared different approaches to remove duplicate records (using ROW_NUMBER, CTEs, DISTINCT, etc.)
4. SQL Query – 7th Highest Salary
 • Write a query to fetch the 7th highest salary from a table
5. PySpark – Gender Percentage Calculation
 • Write a PySpark program to calculate male and female percentage from employee data
6. ADF + ADLS + SQL Server – SCD Type 2 Implementation
 • Explained how to implement SCD Type 2 using Azure Data Factory with ADLS as source and SQL Server as target
 • Discussed how to handle failures during pipeline execution
7. Spark Caching – Real Use Case
 • Shared a real project use case where Spark caching improved performance
8. Optimization Techniques
 • Discussed project-level (not theoretical) optimizations applied for better performance
9. Problem Solving in Projects
 • Talked about a real issue encountered during the project and how I resolved it
10. Data Security & Governance
 • Explained how I ensured data security and governance in my pipeline and architecture
Key Takeaway:
The round emphasized practical experience and real-world problem-solving. Highly recommend being confident with:
 • SQL logic and edge cases
 • PySpark transformations
 • Azure Data Factory pipeline design
 • Data security & project-level optimizations

All the best to everyone preparing for interviews!
